question: Add a new required field AuthConfig AuthenticationConfig to the DataSourceConnection struct in Grafana's datasource API types. DataSourceConnection defines how Grafana connects to backends like Prometheus, Loki, Mimir, and Tempo. All datasource plugins constructing this struct will break.

change.before:
type DataSourceConnection struct {
	Title string `json:"title"`
	Name string `json:"name"`
	APIGroup string `json:"group"`
	APIVersion string `json:"version"`
	Plugin string `json:"plugin,omitempty"`
}
change.after:
type DataSourceConnection struct {
	Title string `json:"title"`
	Name string `json:"name"`
	APIGroup string `json:"group"`
	APIVersion string `json:"version"`
	Plugin string `json:"plugin,omitempty"`
	AuthConfig AuthenticationConfig `json:"authConfig"`
}
change.description: New required field AuthConfig added to DataSourceConnection struct. All struct literal instantiations and auto-generated code must be updated.

breaking_patterns.example:
return &queryV0.DataSourceConnection{
	Title: ds.Name,
	APIGroup: fmt.Sprintf("%s.datasource.grafana.app", ds.Type),
	APIVersion: "v0alpha1",
	Name: ds.UID,
	Plugin: ds.Type,
}
breaking_patterns.why_breaks: Struct literal instantiation missing required AuthConfig field causes compile error
Test code creating partial struct literals will fail compilation without AuthConfig field
Auto-generated deepcopy code needs regeneration to handle new field if it's a complex type
OpenAPI schema must be regenerated to include authConfig in properties and required fields list
Factory functions that construct and return DataSourceConnection must provide AuthConfig value
